courses.overview: 由電容負載、機械共振與位移回授延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend capacitive loading, mechanical resonance and displacement feedback into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 超音波換能器電子系統
related.why: 超音波換能器同樣包含壓電耦合和機械共振。
related.whyEn: Ultrasonic transducers also use piezoelectric coupling/resonance.
related.transfer: 超音波換能器同樣包含壓電耦合和機械共振。
related.transferEn: Ultrasonic transducers also use piezoelectric coupling/resonance.
related.difference: 定位重視準靜態行程，測距重視脈衝和回波。
related.differenceEn: Positioning emphasizes quasi-static stroke; ranging emphasizes bursts/echoes.
practice: 把「壓電轉換」的概念圖與「超音波換能器電子系統」的輸入輸出對照。
對相同幅度比較正弦和有限斜率階躍。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：定位重視準靜態行程，測距重視脈衝和回波。
practiceEn: Compare the piezoelectric conversion concept map with inputs/outputs of Ultrasonic-transducer electronics.
Compare a sine and slew-limited step of equal amplitude.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Positioning emphasizes quasi-static stroke; ranging emphasizes bursts/echoes.

related.title: 伺服馬達編碼器整合
related.why: 致動器回授可借用位置感測和伺服的誤差模型。

related.transfer: 致動器回授可借用位置感測和伺服的誤差模型。
related.transferEn: Actuator feedback uses position sensing and servo error models.
related.difference: 壓電遲滯、蠕變和容性負載不同於旋轉馬達。
related.differenceEn: Piezo hysteresis, creep and capacitive load differ from rotary motors.
practice: 把「自由行程與阻擋力」的概念圖與「伺服馬達編碼器整合」的輸入輸出對照。
比較充放電一週期的來源與負載能量。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：壓電遲滯、蠕變和容性負載不同於旋轉馬達。
practiceEn: Compare the free stroke and blocked force concept map with inputs/outputs of Servo-motor encoder integration.
Compare source/load energy over a charge/discharge cycle.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Piezo hysteresis, creep and capacitive load differ from rotary motors.

courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Texas Instruments 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。電場引起應變，方向和材料極化決定位移。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「電容負載、機械共振與位移回授」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Texas Instruments provides a traceable starting point. Electric field creates strain; direction and polarization determine displacement. Independently authored models connect this to capacitive loading, mechanical resonance and displacement feedback; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：同一電壓在升降掃描可能對應不同位移。 以「繪出電壓位移閉合迴線。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: One voltage can produce different displacement on rising/falling sweeps. Practice interpretation using: Plot a voltage/displacement hysteresis loop. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
